riders.design: A very large cheerful pink Poring slime, plump translucent jelly oval with glossy pink highlights, small black oval eyes, tiny w-shaped smile, rosy cheeks. Preserve the substantial brown leather satchel-like saddle around its back: silver zipper trim, buckled side harness bands, broad rear pouch and inset riding seat. No limbs on the slime.
riders.rider: A cheerful young adult female novice, honey-blonde chin-length bob with one small side braid tied in a blue ribbon, turquoise eyes, cream blouse, mustard-yellow short capelet, navy riding shorts, brown gloves and knee-high brown riding boots. She sits securely in the inset saddle, holding the front leather grip, both legs naturally on opposite sides. No helmet.

riders.design: The SAME sacred white fox as the model: slender white fluffy fox body, dark chocolate brown lower legs, three long white bushy tails with dark brown tips, red eye makeup and red forehead markings, little tall black ceremonial hat, thick braided red-and-white shimenawa ropes, polished golden bells and red tassels. Keep all these distinctive ornaments; exactly four legs.
riders.rider: An elegant young adult female ranger with long dark-teal hair tied into a high ponytail by a white ribbon, amber eyes, forest-green short riding coat over an ivory tunic, brown fitted trousers, fitted leather gloves and tall dark-brown boots, small gold leaf clasp at collar. Both legs straddle the fox naturally behind its shoulders; hands hold a simple leather rein below the fox's neck rope.

riders.rider: A young adult female mage with short lavender bob hair, violet eyes, a small tilted plum-purple witch hat with a gold crescent pin, ivory blouse, layered plum riding dress over dark leggings, dark ankle boots and fitted gloves.
